Bring classic utility charm into your collection or decor with this set of four vintage glass insulators. These iconic pieces feature beautiful blue-green tones and embossed lettering, giving them a distinctly industrial, early-20th-century look. They make great display pieces on a shelf or windowsill, or can be repurposed in creative projects like lamps, garden accents, or rustic centerpieces. Each insulator has its own character from years of use, with one showing a more pronounced crack and chipping at the base, adding to the authentic, weathered appeal. This listing includes four glass insulators in varying shapes and shades of aqua/teal, all with embossed text and ridged bases or tops for that unmistakable vintage style.
